All timestamps are UTC. Full metrics are sampled every 1 second; scheduling and batch metrics every 100ms. Request quantiles use a 30-second window and scheduling/batch quantiles a 1-second window. Histogram quantiles are approximate; last-value curves show the most recently submitted real batch. Prefill and decode are aggregated separately. Hover over a chart to see sample values and a shared time cursor.

TPOT is computed once per completed request choice: (last output time − first output time) / (output tokens − 1). The overview shows quantiles across completed request choices, not one request's token-by-token latency. Inspect a request below for its own TPOT and output batch intervals. ATOM measures engine callbacks; see AIPerf for client-side SSE timing.

Streaming requests · Per-request metrics


Select a prefill or decode JSONL file from the artifact events/ directory. Load request IDs, then select a request and choice. MTP may emit multiple tokens per callback: the charts retain output batch intervals and token counts, not client SSE arrival times or inferred per-token timestamps. Unfinished or cancelled requests may have only output_chunk events. Event logs remain in the CI artifact.
